_meta: DRAFT — NOT YET IMPORTED (wired automatically by the gen-slices auto-loader). Municipal-tier population-priority push, 2026-08-13 (AF/G.18), round 8 of 10. Mozambique — one of Africa's longer-running municipal decentralization systems (directly-elected municipalities since 1997). Found a concrete, quantitative transfer formula (Fundo de Compensação Autárquica) in a 2008 finance law, plus the current 2023 organic law — but individual-municipality budget publication is thin-to-nonexistent online, and one candidate .gov.mz domain (Matola) was found compromised with spam content, flagged for the corpus's own integrity.

reports.title: Lei n.º 12/2023, de 25 de Agosto — Lei de bases da criação, organização e funcionamento das autarquias locais
reports.description: Mozambique's CURRENT organic municipal law, verified via direct PDF download and pdftotext extraction of the official Boletim da República (I Série, Número 165, Suplemento, 25 August 2023) — supersedes Lei n.º 6/2018 (itself amended/republished by Lei n.º 13/2018), which superseded the original 1997 framework. Art. 16 (Autonomia): "1. As autarquias locais gozam de autonomia administrativa, financeira e patrimonial. ... 3. A autonomia financeira compreende os poderes de: a) elaborar, aprovar, alterar e executar planos de actividades e orçamento; b) elaborar e aprovar as contas de gerência; c) dispor de receitas próprias, ordenar e processar as despesas e arrecadar as receitas que, por lei, forem destinadas às autarquias; ... e) recorrer a empréstimos." Art. 50(1) grants the Municipal Assembly explicit budget powers: "a) aprovar posturas; b) aprovar o orçamento do município e as suas revisões; ... i) estabelecer taxas autárquicas derramas e outras receitas próprias." This 2023 law establishes the powers but does not itself name specific taxes or the compensation-fund formula — those live in the separate finance law, mz-lei-1-2008-regime-financeiro-autarquico.
reports.cadence_note: One-off foundational legal instrument, current as of 2023 (post-dates and repeals Lei 6/2018).

reports.title: Lei n.° 1/2008, de 16 de Janeiro — Regime financeiro, orçamental e patrimonial das autarquias locais e o Sistema Tributário Autárquico
reports.description: Mozambique's municipal finance law, verified via a Wayback Machine capture (2011) of the originating Ministério da Administração Estatal PDF, which is now offline (mae.gov.mz unreachable) — same primary text, accessed via the earliest available archival mirror rather than a dead live host. KEY FINDING — Art. 43(2): "O montante do Fundo de Compensação Autárquica é objecto de uma dotação própria a inscrever no Orçamento do Estado e é constituído por 1,5% das receitas fiscais previstas no respectivo ano económico" [The Fundo de Compensação Autárquica (FCA) amount is set by its own appropriation in the State Budget and consists of 1.5% of the fiscal revenue projected for the relevant economic year]. Art. 43(3): the fund's proceeds are "de afectação livre pelas autarquias beneficiárias" [freely allocable by the recipient municipalities]. Art. 44's distribution formula: "FCAa = NHa/NHT x 75%FCA + Ata/ATT x 25%FCA" — each municipality's share is 75% weighted by its population share (Número de Habitantes) and 25% by its territorial-area share (Área Territorial). Art. 51 lists the municipal tax system: Imposto Pessoal Autárquico, Imposto Predial Autárquico (IPRA), Imposto Autárquico de Veículos, Imposto Autárquico de Sisa, Contribuição de Melhorias, plus fee-based (not tax-based) 'taxas por Licenças Concedidas e por Actividade Económica.'
reports.cadence_note: One-off foundational legal instrument (still in force as of this round; not superseded by Lei 12/2023, which governs institutional structure rather than finance).

reports.title: IPRA — Imposto Predial Autárquico (Conselho Municipal da Cidade de Pemba)
reports.publisher: Conselho Municipal da Cidade de Pemba
reports.description: A genuine .gov.mz municipal-government-authored page (Pemba, not one of Mozambique's four largest cities but a real, currently-active municipality) publishing actual applied property-tax rates: "O Imposto Predial Autárquico (IPRA) é um tributo municipal anual que incide sobre o valor patrimonial dos prédios urbanos situados no território do município... Habitação: Taxa de 0.4% sobre o valor patrimonial. Comércio/Indústria/Outros: Taxa de 0.7% sobre o valor patrimonial." CAVEAT: the page cites 'Lei n.º 1/2008' Articles 4, 35, 38-40, 44, 54-55 for its valuation/payment-schedule provisions, but cross-checking against the verified Lei 1/2008 text shows its actual Art. 44 is the FCA distribution FORMULA (see mz-lei-1-2008-regime-financeiro-autarquico), not an IPRA calculation provision — the municipal page's article citations appear to be misattributed, likely actually referring to a subordinate Código Tributário Autárquico (candidate: Decreto n.º 63/2008) that could not be independently located/verified this round (404). Use this as evidence IPRA is actively administered with real rates; do not treat its specific article citations as verified.
reports.cadence_note: Standing municipal tax-rate page, not dated to a specific fiscal year edition.

dependencies.basis: Lei 12/2023's Art. 16(3)(c) grants municipalities the power to 'dispor de receitas próprias... que, por lei, forem destinadas às autarquias' — a direct reference to the separate finance law (Lei 1/2008) that actually enumerates those own-source revenues and the FCA transfer formula, without repeating that content itself.

Pemba's own IPRA page explicitly attributes its property-tax basis to 'Lei n.º 1/2008, de 16 de Janeiro' by name, even though its specific article-number citations could not be independently verified against that law's actual text (see this node's own caveat).

_dropped.edge: INE Moçambique's CPI methodology -> COICOP / IMF-ILO CPI Manual / SADC HCPI / African Charter on Statistics (new base-year bulletin)
_dropped.why: INE's live 'ipc-com-novo-ano-base' page (announcing the 2023=100 rebasing) describes base year, basket size (367 products, up from 316), and weighting source (2022 Household Budget Survey) but does NOT name COICOP, the IMF/ILO CPI Manual, SADC HCPI, or the African Charter anywhere in its text — a genuine negative on this specific page. The deeper methodology document ('Do IOF ao IPC.pdf', likely to cover this) could not be read this round: direct curl/WebFetch failed on ine.gov.mz's TLS handshake, and a browser tool loaded the PDF into a viewer but could not extract/screenshot it due to a tooling restriction on that specific tab. Genuinely inconclusive/inaccessible, not a confirmed absence — distinct from mz-ine-ipc's own existing corpus description, which already documents a DIFFERENT INE bulletin explicitly naming both COICOP and the 'Manual do IPC das Nações Unidas 2009' by name, so the methodology-manual citation question is independently already resolved positive elsewhere in the corpus; this note concerns only the newer 2023=100 rebasing bulletin specifically.
